issues.description: OutputImageRawFrame uses raw image.tobytes() but PIL may return non-RGB mode causing format mismatch
issues.detail: Image.open() on Gemini-returned bytes can yield modes like RGBA, P, or L. Calling image.tobytes() then declaring format='RGB' will send mis-sized/wrong-channel buffers to the transport, breaking video_out which expects 1024x1024 RGB. Must convert with image.convert('RGB') before tobytes().

issues.description: Mutating private genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE at import time is fragile and global
issues.detail: Reaching into a private module attribute (_api_client) of google-genai monkey-patches the SDK globally for any consumer of pipecat. This will silently break when google-genai is upgraded past 1.41 and removes/renames the attribute, and it affects unrelated Google clients in the same process. Needs a guarded try/except and an issue link explaining the hack.

issues.description: Default model bumped from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash is a breaking change
issues.detail: Users relying on the implicit default will see different pricing, latency, and behavior on upgrade. CHANGELOG mentions it under 'Changed' but this is a behavior-affecting default swap and should at minimum be called out as potentially breaking, ideally with a deprecation/version-gating note.

issues.description: Image-model detection via substring 'image' in model name is brittle
issues.detail: Using `if 'image' in self._model_name` to suppress thinking budget will match any future model with 'image' in its identifier, including non-Gemini-image variants, and may miss image-capable models named differently (e.g., 'nano-banana'). Prefer an explicit list or capability check.

issues.description: Generated images are pushed as frames but never appended to context or aggregator
issues.detail: The example uses LLMContextAggregatorPair to track assistant turns, but image parts are pushed directly via push_frame without being recorded in the context messages. On a follow-up turn the model has no record it produced an image, harming multi-turn coherence and possibly causing duplicate generation.

issues.description: Example docstring claims Gemini TTS/STT but uses Google Cloud TTS/STT services
issues.detail: The module docstring says 'using Gemini for both LLM, STT and TTS' but the code instantiates GoogleSTTService and GoogleTTSService (Google Cloud Speech/TTS), not Gemini. Misleading for users copying the example.

review.summary: The PR adds Gemini image generation to GoogleLLMService with a useful example and bumps Google SDK pins. The most serious concerns are around correctness of the image frame conversion (no PIL mode normalization before tobytes(), so non-RGB outputs will corrupt the video frame) and a fragile monkey-patch of a private google-genai attribute at import time. The default model change and substring-based image-model detection are behavioral risks worth tightening. Example docstring is also misleading about which services it actually uses.
